article_title: From flip flops to fisherman's sandals: Are your summer sandals killing your feet?

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main message about summer sandals?
options: Every sandal is harmful and should be avoided
Fashion matters more than foot health
Different designs place different demands on the feet, so support and fit matter
Only expensive sandals can protect the feet
tasks.correct_answer: Different designs place different demands on the feet, so support and fit matter
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה אינה קובעת שכל הסנדלים רעים; היא מסבירה שהמבנה, התמיכה וההתאמה משפיעים על העומס בכף הרגל.

tasks.prompt: According to podiatrist Dr Helen Branthwaite, why can frequent flip-flop use increase injury risk?
options: The foot works under more strain than normal
Flip-flops always make the feet too hot
Their colour changes how people walk
They stop the toes from moving at all
tasks.correct_answer: The foot works under more strain than normal
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ברנתווייט מסבירה שכף הרגל עובדת תחת עומס גדול מהרגיל, ולכן נעשית חשופה יותר לפציעה.

tasks.prompt: What feature helps a sturdier sandal support the shape of the foot?
options: A completely flat paper-thin sole
A decorative metal buckle only
A contoured footbed with arch support
A loose strap that never touches the ankle
tasks.correct_answer: A contoured footbed with arch support
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מצע מעוצב לפי צורת כף הרגל ותמיכה בקשת מפזרים את העומס בצורה טובה יותר.

tasks.prompt: What advice does the article give about changing to minimalist barefoot shoes?
options: Wear them all day immediately
Use them only with thick socks
Choose the smallest possible size
Ease into them gradually
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההמלצה היא להסתגל לנעליים מינימליסטיות בהדרגה ולא לעבור אליהן בבת אחת.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “prone to injury” mean?
options: Guaranteed to recover quickly
More likely to be injured
Unable to feel any pain
Protected from physical strain
tasks.explanation_hebrew: prone to פירושו בעל נטייה או סיכוי מוגבר לחוות דבר מסוים; כאן מדובר בפציעה.

options: The part of a sandal shaped to support the foot
A fashion forecast for summer shoes
A cream used on dry skin
The strap around the ankle
tasks.correct_answer: The part of a sandal shaped to support the foot
tasks.explanation_hebrew: contoured פירושו מותאם לצורה, ו־footbed הוא המשטח שעליו כף הרגל נחה.

tasks.prompt: Use the article's context to explain the difference between “arch”, “sole” and “footbed”. Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להגדיר את קשת כף הרגל, את הסוליה החיצונית ואת המשטח הפנימי שעליו הרגל נחה.
expected_points: The arch is the curved part of the foot
The sole is the bottom part of the shoe or sandal
The footbed is the inner surface that supports the foot

tasks.prompt: Why is the statement “all flip-flops are bad” too simple, according to the article? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שההשפעה תלויה במשך השימוש, במבנה הסנדל, בתמיכה ובהסתגלות של האדם, ולא רק בשם הסגנון.
expected_points: Branthwaite says it is not accurate to label all flip-flops as bad
Foot strain depends on how and how often the footwear is used
Support, fit and the wearer's adaptation affect the risk

tasks.prompt: Write a 80–110 word summary comparing flip-flops, sturdier supportive sandals and minimalist barefoot shoes.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין העומס האפשרי בכפכפים, התמיכה במצע מעוצב ובקשת, והצורך בהסתגלות הדרגתית לנעליים מינימליסטיות.
expected_points: Frequent flip-flop use can place extra strain on the foot
Sturdier sandals may offer a contoured footbed and arch support
No single sandal style is automatically harmful for everyone
Minimalist barefoot shoes should be introduced gradually

tasks.prompt: Recommend a summer sandal for a day with a lot of walking. Use at least three terms from the article and write 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להמליץ באופן מעשי ולהשתמש נכון בלפחות שלושה מונחים כגון arch, strain, contoured, footbed, ankle, sturdy או sole.
expected_points: Choose a secure and sturdier design
Mention a contoured footbed or arch support
Explain how the choice may reduce strain or injury risk
Use at least three article vocabulary terms accurately
